scientific_integrity: Witness words and doubled matching-dual potentials are embedded; an executable standard-library checker reconstructs all finite signed graphs and verifies exhaustive shortest-path dual inequalities and coverage. No independent scientific audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The four exact finite orders 6,7,8,9 are proved for binary linear words with reversal equivalence; no larger-order, circular, complement-equivalence, or other-alphabet result is claimed. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact shortest binary unoriented de Bruijn words at orders six through nine
